title: Reflection of finite local systems on the coefficient-sized models
statement: Let X be any scheme, A a commutative Noetherian ring in max(v,u+1), and F a fixed-scalar A-module sheaf on the coefficient-sized etale site [def-pe-etale-constructible-module]. If its fixed-scalar comparison inverse image along the transported etale inclusion [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] is locally constant with finitely generated constant module models on covering sieves, then F satisfies the same finite local-model condition on the etale site. This is a single-stratum statement, with no scheme partition or global constructibility conclusion.

proof.text: Apply the finite local-model hypothesis on each object and replace finite generation by finite presentation using Noetherianity. Apply coefficientFpLocalSystem_etaleCover to the actual comparison inverse image. This produces coefficient-sized etale objects V_i whose images cover the pro-etale site and constant slice charts with finitely presented models M_i.

Reflect the cover through the transported inclusion directly: push the model covering sieve down through AsSmall, extract a generating pro-etale covering presieve at the terminal object, and use its joint surjectivity. Factoring each of its members through an etale V_i shows the underlying etale family is jointly surjective. The etale covering criterion gives a covering sieve of these objects, and AsSmall transports it to the coefficient-sized etale site. This is the fully proved private helper comparison_coversTop_reflect, including the empty-family and empty-base cases.

Reflect each supplied constant chart on the single etale object V_i, preserving its module M_i. For an arbitrary etale site object W use Sieve.ofObjects V W, which is covering by the preceding step. Each arrow of this sieve has domain U admitting q:U→V_i. Restrict the reflected chart along q; pushforwardOverMapIso identifies the restricted F with F.over U, and pushforwardContinuousSheafificationCompatibility identifies the restricted constant sheaf with constant M_i. Finite presentation implies finite generation, giving precisely the required witnesses on this sieve. No nonempty-chart or nonzero-model choice is made.

proof_origin.place: Tags 099Y and 099T; coefficient-sized assembly using the existing etale-chart theorem and one-chart reflection. Cover reflection uses joint surjectivity and the small etale covering criterion.

theorem coefficientComparison_finite_reflect (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (F : Sheaf (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
      (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A))
    (h : IsCoefficientModelLocallyConstantFinite
      (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A
      ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
        (Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} X) (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)
        (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
        (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)).obj F)) :
    IsCoefficientModelLocallyConstantFinite
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A F
